<SYSTEM>This is the full developer documentation for Dovetail</SYSTEM>

# Dovetail

> Joint-driven application wiring for .NET. AOT-safe, zero runtime reflection.

AOT & Trim Safe

Generated code requires zero runtime reflection — fully compatible with .NET Native AOT and IL trimming.

Module Wiring

Define services, configuration, logging, and hosting as assembly-level joints resolved at build time by a Roslyn source generator.

Composable

First-class support for Generic Host, ASP.NET Core, Autofac, DryIoc, Serilog, and .NET Aspire — all wired automagically.

# API Reference

> Auto-generated API reference for all public Dovetail packages.

API reference documentation is auto-generated from XML doc comments in the source, one page per assembly. Run `mise run docs:api` (docfx metadata + docfx2astro) before running the docs site — see `mise run docs:build`.

[Hosting](/api/dovetail.hosting/)Generic host integration APIs.

[Configuration (TOML)](/api/dovetail.configuration.toml/)TOML configuration joint APIs.

[Configuration (YAML)](/api/dovetail.configuration.yaml/)YAML configuration joint APIs.

[Aspire](/api/dovetail.aspire/).NET Aspire hosting joints, including testing integration.

[Autofac](/api/dovetail.autofac/)Autofac container integration APIs.

[DryIoc](/api/dovetail.dryioc/)DryIoc container integration APIs.

[Serilog](/api/dovetail.serilog/)Serilog logging joint APIs.

# ConfigurationKeyStyle Enum

> How Dovetail.Attributes.DovetailConfigurationAttribute spells the configuration keys of an options type and of every object type nested in it.

## Definition

How [DovetailConfigurationAttribute](../dovetail.attributes.dovetailconfigurationattribute/) spells the configuration keys of an options type and of every object type nested in it.

C#

```csharp
public enum ConfigurationKeyStyle
```

## Remarks

The style decides the canonical key of every bound property and constructor parameter, in both the generated binder and the configuration schema. It also decides the default section path derived from the type name. A \[ConfigurationKeyName] on a member is always used as written, and an explicit section path is never changed. Dictionary keys, enum values and other data are never restyled.

Word splitting matches \[JsonNamingPolicy]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonnamingpolicy/): \[Camel]\(../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#camel) is \[CamelCase]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonnamingpolicy.camelcase/), \[Dash]\(../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#dash) is \[KebabCaseLower]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonnamingpolicy.kebabcaselower/) and \[Underscore]\(../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#underscore) is \[SnakeCaseLower]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.text.json.jsonnamingpolicy.snakecaselower/).

The generated binder exists once for each type, so a type reached from sections of styles that spell its keys differently is reported as DT0016.

## Fields

### Undefined

Nothing is respelled: the canonical key is the declared name exactly as written, and the derived section path is the type name without its suffix. Configuration keys ignore case, so data in any casing binds, as long as the letters are right. This is the default.

C#

```csharp
Undefined = 0
```

### Pascal

The declared name with its first letter upper-cased: maxFileSizeMb becomes MaxFileSizeMb, and GreetingsOptions is the section Greetings. For the usual C# property name this is the same as [Undefined](../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#undefined).

C#

```csharp
Pascal = 1
```

### Camel

Lower camel case: MaxFileSizeMb becomes maxFileSizeMb, HTTPServer becomes httpServer, and HttpClientOptions is the section httpClient. Configuration keys ignore case, so this only changes the spelling the schema suggests.

C#

```csharp
Camel = 2
```

### Dash

Lower-case words joined with -: MaxFileSizeMb becomes max-file-size-mb, and HttpClientOptions is the section http-client. The binder reads exactly these keys, so a value written as MaxFileSizeMb no longer binds.

C#

```csharp
Dash = 3
```

### Underscore

Lower-case words joined with \_: MaxFileSizeMb becomes max_file_size_mb, and HttpClientOptions is the section http_client. The binder reads exactly these keys, so a value written as MaxFileSizeMb no longer binds.

C#

```csharp
Underscore = 4
```

# DovetailConfigurationAttribute Class

> Declares the configuration section of an options class. Dovetail's source generator describes the class as JSON Schema, which is merged into the application's appsettings.schema.json for editor completion and validation, and registers it with the options pipeline.

## Definition

Declares the configuration section of an options class. Dovetail’s source generator describes the class as JSON Schema, which is merged into the application’s appsettings.schema.json for editor completion and validation, and registers it with the options pipeline.

C#

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class)]
[Conditional("CodeGeneration")]
public sealed class DovetailConfigurationAttribute : Attribute
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/) → [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute/)

## Remarks

Without a section path the section is the type name with an Options, Settings, Configuration or Config suffix removed, so GreetingsOptions becomes Greetings. Nested sections use :, as in "Http:Retry".

A type has one section, so it can be declared once. For a type you don't own, use the assembly form, \`\`Dovetail.Attributes.DovetailConfigurationAttribute1\`\`.

\[KeyStyle]\(../dovetail.attributes.dovetailconfigurationattribute/#keystyle) picks how the keys of the type and of the types nested in it are spelled (as declared, Pascal, camel, dash or underscore case). A type that several sections reach has to spell its keys the same way in all of them; DT0016 reports a mismatch.

The generated registration reads its own section from the application's complete IConfiguration and creates or binds the options.

Only works with source generators enabled.

## Constructors

### DovetailConfigurationAttribute()

Declares the attributed class under the section derived from its name.

C#

```csharp
public DovetailConfigurationAttribute()
```

### DovetailConfigurationAttribute(string)

Declares the attributed class under section.

C#

```csharp
public DovetailConfigurationAttribute(string section)
```

#### Parameters

`section` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string/)\
The section path, e.g. “Greetings” or “Http:Retry”.

## Properties

### Section

The section path, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) for the one derived from the type name.

C#

```csharp
public string? Section { get; }
```

### RegisterOptions

Whether to register IOptions for the type. [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) only describes the section in the schema. The default is [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool RegisterOptions { get; set; }
```

### ValidateOnStart

Whether to validate the options when the host starts. The default is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool ValidateOnStart { get; set; }
```

### KeyStyle

How the configuration keys are spelled: those of every bound property and constructor parameter of the options type and of the object types nested in it, and the default section path derived from the type name. The default is [Undefined](../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#undefined), which keeps the declared names. See [ConfigurationKeyStyle](../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/).

C#

```csharp
public ConfigurationKeyStyle KeyStyle { get; set; }
```

# DovetailConfigurationAttribute<T> Class

> Declares the configuration section of an options type T from the assembly, for types you don't own.

## Definition

Declares the configuration section of an options type T from the assembly, for types you don’t own.

C#

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Assembly, AllowMultiple = true)]
[Conditional("CodeGeneration")]
public sealed class DovetailConfigurationAttribute<T> : Attribute where T : class
```

### Type Parameters

`T`\
The options type.

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/) → [Attribute](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.attribute/)

## Remarks

For example, \[assembly: DovetailConfiguration("Hosting")].

The section path follows the same rules as \[DovetailConfigurationAttribute]\(../dovetail.attributes.dovetailconfigurationattribute/). Apply it once for each type you configure. A type has one section: naming it twice, or also declaring it with the class form, is reported as DT0015. \`\`Dovetail.Attributes.DovetailConfigurationAttribute1.KeyStyle\`\` works as it does on the class form.

Only works with source generators enabled.

## Constructors

### DovetailConfigurationAttribute()

Declares T under the section derived from its name.

C#

```csharp
public DovetailConfigurationAttribute()
```

### DovetailConfigurationAttribute(string)

Declares T under section.

C#

```csharp

```

The section path, e.g. “Greetings” or “Http:Retry”.

C#

### RegisterOptions

Whether to register IOptions for the type. [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) only describes the section in the schema. The default is [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool RegisterOptions { get; set; }
```

### ValidateOnStart

Whether to validate the options when the host starts. The default is [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool ValidateOnStart { get; set; }
```

### KeyStyle

How the configuration keys are spelled: those of every bound property and constructor parameter of the options type and of the object types nested in it, and the default section path derived from the type name. The default is [Undefined](../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/#undefined), which keeps the declared names. See [ConfigurationKeyStyle](../dovetail.attributes.configurationkeystyle/).

C#

```csharp

```

# DovetailHostTypeAttribute Class

> Defines the host type of a given convention

## Definition

C#


# MergeConfigurationSchema Class

> Merges the configuration schema fragments of an application (or test project) and every assembly it references into its appsettings.schema.json, closing Dovetail's sections strictly and embedding SchemaStore's appsettings schema.

## Definition

Merges the configuration schema fragments of an application (or test project) and every assembly it references into its appsettings.schema.json, closing Dovetail’s sections strictly and embedding SchemaStore’s appsettings schema.

C#

```csharp
public sealed class MergeConfigurationSchema : Task, ITask
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/) → [Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.build.utilities.task/)

Implements [ITask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.build.framework.itask/)

## Remarks

Fragments are read from assembly metadata, so nothing is loaded. Unreadable assemblies, unknown fragment versions and malformed fragments are skipped with a low-importance message rather than failing the build.

## Properties

### References

The resolved references (@(ReferencePath)), as absolute paths.



The absolute path of the schema to write.

C#

```csharp

```

### Strict

Whether to close Dovetail’s sections with case-insensitive propertyNames patterns. Defaults to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool Strict { get; set; }
```

### IncludeSchemaStore

Whether to embed SchemaStore’s appsettings schema as the base. Defaults to [true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

C#

```csharp
public bool IncludeSchemaStore { get; set; }
```


true, if successful

# ScaffoldEditorSettings Class

> Creates or updates Dovetail's own mappings for a host in a VS Code .vscode/settings.json, namely json.schemas, yaml.schemas and evenBetterToml.schema.associations, each pointing at the host's merged appsettings.schema.json. Everything else in the file is left as it is (see Dovetail.Build.Tasks.VsCodeSettingsEditor).

## Definition

Creates or updates Dovetail’s own mappings for a host in a VS Code .vscode/settings.json, namely json.schemas, yaml.schemas and evenBetterToml.schema.associations, each pointing at the host’s merged appsettings.schema.json. Everything else in the file is left as it is (see `Dovetail.Build.Tasks.VsCodeSettingsEditor`).

C#

```csharp
public sealed class ScaffoldEditorSettings : Task, ITask
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/) → [Task](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.build.utilities.task/)

Implements [ITask](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.build.framework.itask/)

## Remarks

A file the task can’t update safely (it doesn’t parse, has an unexpected shape or is read-only) is not touched: the task logs a warning with the mappings to paste instead. The file and its .vscode folder are created only when missing. Nothing is written, and the file’s timestamp is left alone, when the mappings are already there.

## Properties

### ProjectDirectory

The host’s project directory, where its appsettings\* files are, as an absolute path.

C#

```csharp
[Required]
public string ProjectDirectory { get; set; }
```

### SchemaFile

The host’s merged schema file, as an absolute path.

C#

```csharp
[Required]
public string SchemaFile { get; set; }
```

### SettingsDirectory

The folder that holds .vscode, as an absolute path. Defaults to the nearest ancestor of the project directory that contains a .git entry, or the project directory itself when there is none.

C#

```csharp
public string SettingsDirectory { get; set; }
```

### SettingsFile

The settings file the task worked on.

C#

```csharp
[Output]
public string SettingsFile { get; set; }
```

### Updated

Whether the task created or changed the file.

C#

```csharp
[Output]
public bool Updated { get; set; }
```

## Methods

### Execute()

Must be implemented by derived class.

C#

```csharp
public override bool Execute()
```

#### Returns

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean/)\
true, if successful

# DovetailConfigurationOptionsExtensions Class

> Registers strongly-typed configuration classes with the standard Microsoft.Extensions.Options pipeline.

## Definition

Registers strongly-typed configuration classes with the standard [Microsoft.Extensions.Options](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.options/) pipeline.

C#

```csharp
public static class DovetailConfigurationOptionsExtensions
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/)

## Remarks

The configuration joint that Dovetail's source generator emits for \[DovetailConfiguration] types calls \`\`Dovetail.DovetailConfigurationOptionsExtensions.AddDovetailConfigurationOptions1(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection%2cSystem.String%2cSystem.Func%7bMicrosoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration%2c0%7d)\`\` for every type, passing the Create… method it generated for it. That code creates the instance and binds the section onto it without reflection, so the registration is trimming and AOT safe, and nothing here uses reflection. A library registers only its own section, and reads it from the application's complete \[IConfiguration]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.configuration.iconfiguration/), which the service provider supplies when the options are first created.

## Methods

### AddDovetailConfigurationOptions\<TOptions>(IServiceCollection, string, Func\<IConfiguration, TOptions>)

Creates TOptions from the configuration section at sectionPath with create, without reflection.

C#

```csharp
public static OptionsBuilder<TOptions> AddDovetailConfigurationOptions<TOptions>(this IServiceCollection services, string sectionPath, Func<IConfiguration, TOptions> create) where TOptions : class
```

#### Parameters

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection/)\
The service collection to register against.

`sectionPath` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string/)\
The path of the configuration section to create from, such as Server or Http:Retry.

`create` [Func\<IConfiguration, TOptions>](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.func-2/)\
Creates an instance from a configuration section.

#### Returns

[OptionsBuilder\<TOptions>](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.options.optionsbuilder-1/)\
The `Microsoft.Extensions.Options.OptionsBuilder1` for the default name, for further configuration such as Validate and ValidateOnStart().

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception/)\
services, sectionPath, or create is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

[ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception/)\
sectionPath is empty.

#### Remarks

This is the one registration the generated configuration joint emits, for every \[DovetailConfiguration] type. It registers an \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsFactory1\`\` that creates each instance with create, unless a factory is already registered for TOptions. That is a TryAdd, so an \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsFactory1\`\` the application registered itself wins over this one, and create is never called for that type. Registered before this call, the application's factory makes this registration a no-op. Registered after it with a plain Add, it is the last registration, which the container resolves. The factory derives from \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.OptionsFactory1\`\`, so configure and post-configure actions and validators still run on the instance create returns.

A type is created from one section only. When several calls register a section for the same type, the first one wins and the rest are ignored, as with any other TryAdd registration.

The configuration is the application's \[IConfiguration]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.configuration.iconfiguration/), which the service provider supplies when the options are first created. create is called with the section at sectionPath. A change token source watches that configuration, so \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsMonitor1\`\` and \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsSnapshot1\`\` observe reloads. Dovetail only registers the default options: asking for any other options name throws \[InvalidOperationException]\(https\://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.invalidoperationexception/).

On .NET 11, don't give a type registered this way asynchronous validators: the options pipeline only runs them through the built-in \`\`Microsoft.Extensions.Options.OptionsFactory1\`\` itself, and through a derived factory they fail synchronous validation.

[true](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool) if context is running under [UnitTest](../dovetail.dovetailhosttype/#unittest); otherwise, [false](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception/)\
context is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

# DovetailEmbeddedConfiguration Class

> Loads configuration files that the Dovetail SDK embedded into an assembly as manifest resources, for hosts that have no file system to read them from (mobile and other app-package hosts).

## Definition

Loads configuration files that the Dovetail SDK embedded into an assembly as manifest resources, for hosts that have no file system to read them from (mobile and other app-package hosts).

C#

```csharp
public static class DovetailEmbeddedConfiguration
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/)

## Remarks

A host turns this on by setting [AssemblyKey](../dovetail.dovetailembeddedconfiguration/#assemblykey) on the context to the assembly that carries the application’s configuration. The configuration joints then read the embedded copies instead of files on disk.

## Fields

### AssemblyKey

The context key that holds the [Assembly](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.reflection.assembly/) the application’s configuration files are embedded in.

C#

```csharp
public const string AssemblyKey = "EmbeddedConfigurationAssembly"
```

## Methods

### OpenResource(Assembly, params ReadOnlySpan\<string>)

Opens the first embedded resource that matches one of fileNames, in order. A resource matches when its name is the file name itself (the Dovetail SDK’s naming) or ends with .{fileName} (the default manifest naming of other tools).

C#

```csharp
public static Stream? OpenResource(Assembly assembly, params ReadOnlySpan<string> fileNames)
```

#### Parameters

`assembly` [Assembly](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.reflection.assembly/)\
The assembly to search.

`fileNames` [ReadOnlySpan\<string>](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1/)\
The candidate file names, most preferred first.

#### Returns

[Stream](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.io.stream/)\
The resource stream, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) if no resource matches.

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception/)\
assembly is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

### GetConventionalFileNames(IDovetailContext, params ReadOnlySpan\<string>)

Gets the conventional configuration file names, lowest precedence first: appsettings, the application name, each of those qualified by the environment name, and each of those qualified by local.

C#

```csharp
public static IReadOnlyList<string> GetConventionalFileNames(IDovetailContext context, params ReadOnlySpan<string> extensions)
```

#### Parameters

`context` [IDovetailContext](../dovetail.idovetailcontext/)\
The context to read the ApplicationName and EnvironmentName from.

`extensions` [ReadOnlySpan\<string>](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.readonlyspan-1/)\
The file extensions to produce names for (without the leading dot), in order at each position.

#### Returns

[IReadOnlyList\<string>](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.ireadonlylist-1/)\
The file names, lowest precedence first.

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception/)\
context is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

# DovetailHostType Enum

> The underlying host type (currently only checked for test host) This is so that conventions can avoid adding behaviors that might cause issues with unit testing such as writing to the console or debug pipes, or ensuring that something is configured in a correct way for testing. Careful consideration is needed to make sure that your system doesn't behave extremely differently in a live scenario vs a testing scenario

## Definition

The underlying host type (currently only checked for test host) This is so that conventions can avoid adding behaviors that might cause issues with unit testing such as writing to the console or debug pipes, or ensuring that something is configured in a correct way for testing. Careful consideration is needed to make sure that your system doesn’t behave extremely differently in a live scenario vs a testing scenario

C#

```csharp
public enum DovetailHostType
```

## Fields

### Undefined

No host type has been defined

C#

```csharp
Undefined = 0
```

### Live

This is a live application This also may apply to in memory integration tests running through the HostBuilder infrastructure

C#

```csharp
Live = 1
```

### UnitTest

This is a unit test context This is so that conventions can avoid adding behaviors that might cause issues with unit testing such as writing to the console or debug pipes, or ensuring that something is configured in a correct way for testing. Careful consideration is needed to make sure that your system doesn’t behave extremely differently in a live scenario vs a testing scenario

C#

```csharp
UnitTest = 2
```

| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

# DovetailConfigurationSchemaEndpointExtensions Class

> Serves the application's merged configuration JSON Schema (appsettings.schema.json) over HTTP.

## Definition

Serves the application’s merged configuration JSON Schema (appsettings.schema.json) over HTTP.

C#

```csharp
public static class DovetailConfigurationSchemaEndpointExtensions
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/)

## Remarks

Applications do not call this directly. Setting the MSBuild property DovetailConfigurationSchemaEndpoint to true generates a joint that maps the endpoint; DovetailConfigurationSchemaEndpointEnvironments restricts it to the listed environments. The implementation uses a plain [RequestDelegate](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.http.requestdelegate/), so it does not rely on reflection and is trimming and AOT friendly.

## Fields

### RoutePattern

The route the schema is served from.

C#

```csharp
public const string RoutePattern = "/.well-known/dovetail/configuration-schema"
```

### SchemaFileName

The name of the schema file, in the application’s output directory and in obj/.

C#

```csharp
public const string SchemaFileName = "appsettings.schema.json"
```

### SchemaMediaType

The media type the schema is served as.

C#

```csharp
public const string SchemaMediaType = "application/schema+json"
```

## Methods

### MapDovetailConfigurationSchema(IEndpointRouteBuilder, string?, string?)

Maps GET /.well-known/dovetail/configuration-schema, which serves appsettings.schema.json from the application’s output directory (falling back to fallbackDirectory). Responds 404 when no file exists, and supports ETag and If-None-Match.

C#

```csharp
public static IEndpointConventionBuilder? MapDovetailConfigurationSchema(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints, string? fallbackDirectory = null, string? environments = null)
```

#### Parameters

`endpoints` [IEndpointRouteBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.routing.iendpointroutebuilder/)\
The endpoint route builder, typically the WebApplication.

`fallbackDirectory` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string/)\
A directory to look in when the output directory has no schema file, typically the project’s obj/ directory when running from source.

`environments` [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string/)\
Semicolon-separated host environment names. When set, the endpoint is only mapped when the current environment is one of them.

#### Returns

[IEndpointConventionBuilder](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.aspnetcore.builder.iendpointconventionbuilder/)\
The endpoint convention builder, or [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null) when environments excludes the current environment.

#### Exceptions

[ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception/)\
endpoints is [null](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/keywords/null).

# IDovetailJoint Interface

> A marker interface to indicate a type is a joint

## Definition

A marker interface to indicate a type is a joint

C#

```csharp
public interface IDovetailJoint
```

## Properties

### Priority

The absolute priority of the convention. If not provided the default value be 0. Use a negative number to push conventions closer to the front. Use a positive number to push conventions closer to the back. Dovetails will still be ordered based on dependencies, so it is possible for a given convention to move front of a convention using int.MinValue.

C#

```csharp
int Priority { get; }
```

# LoggingConnector Class

> A joint that registers logging services into the context.  This joint is automatically registered by the Dovetail generator, so it is not necessary to register this joint manually.

## Definition

A joint that registers logging services into the context. This joint is automatically registered by the Dovetail generator, so it is not necessary to register this joint manually.

C#

```csharp
[ConnectsJoint<ILoggingJoint>]
public sealed class LoggingConnector : IServiceAsyncJoint, IDovetailJoint
```

## Methods

### ApplyAutofac(ContainerBuilder, IDovetailContext, CancellationToken)

Applies the registered Autofac parts.

```csharp

```

#### Parameters

`context` [IDovetailContext](../dovetail.idovetailcontext/)

| [SerilogConfigurationJoint](../dovetail.serilog.serilogconfigurationjoint/)     | Hand-authored stand-in for the generator-emitted IConfigurationJoint that openspec/changes/dovetail-managed-configuration will eventually emit for this library’s appsettings.json (see design.md, Decision 4). | [SerilogRuntimeConfiguration](../dovetail.serilog.serilogruntimeconfiguration/) | Hand-authored stand-in for the generator-emitted configuration class that openspec/changes/dovetail-managed-configuration will eventually produce for appsettings.json’s Serilog section (see design.md, Decision 4). Dogfoods the runtime half of the pipeline (task 8.3) ahead of the generator landing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

# SerilogConfigurationJoint Class

> Hand-authored stand-in for the generator-emitted IConfigurationJoint that openspec/changes/dovetail-managed-configuration will eventually emit for this library's appsettings.json (see design.md, Decision 4). Registers Dovetail.Serilog.SerilogRuntimeConfiguration with Microsoft's Configure<TOptions>(IConfiguration), which binds the Serilog section of the context's Configuration with the reflection-based configuration binder and observes reloads. The generator emits a reflection-free registration instead, so this handwritten one is retired once it does.

## Definition

Hand-authored stand-in for the generator-emitted IConfigurationJoint that openspec/changes/dovetail-managed-configuration will eventually emit for this library’s appsettings.json (see design.md, Decision 4). Registers [SerilogRuntimeConfiguration](../dovetail.serilog.serilogruntimeconfiguration/) with Microsoft’s Configure(IConfiguration), which binds the Serilog section of the context’s Configuration with the reflection-based configuration binder and observes reloads. The generator emits a reflection-free registration instead, so this handwritten one is retired once it does.

C#

```csharp
public sealed class SerilogConfigurationJoint : IServiceJoint, IDovetailJoint
```

Inheritance [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object/)

Implements [IServiceJoint](../dovetail.joints.iservicejoint/), [IDovetailJoint](../dovetail.infrastructure.idovetailjoint/)

## Methods

### Register(IDovetailContext, IServiceCollection)

Register the Service part.

C#

```csharp
[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("Trimming", "IL2026", Justification = "Dogfood stand-in for generator-emitted binding; Configure<T> binds through the reflection-based ConfigurationBinder.")]
[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("AOT", "IL3050", Justification = "Dogfood stand-in for generator-emitted binding; Configure<T> binds through the reflection-based ConfigurationBinder.")]
public void Register(IDovetailContext context, IServiceCollection services)
```

#### Parameters

`context` [IDovetailContext](../dovetail.idovetailcontext/)

`services` [IServiceCollection](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/microsoft.extensions.dependencyinjection.iservicecollection/)
